dedupe_keys.name: three year building operational performance dataset lbnl building 59 berkeley

description: This dataset gives three years of curated operational data for an office building built in 2015 in Berkeley, California: whole-building and end-use energy, HVAC operating conditions, indoor and outdoor environmental parameters and occupant counts. It was curated by Tianzhen Hong, Na Luo, David Blum and Zhe Wang of Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory from more than 300 sensors and meters on two office floors of 2,325 square metres each. Curation had three steps: cleaning outliers and gaps, building a Brick schema model of the systems and points, and describing the dataset with a semantic JSON schema. Access: a 263 MB zip with README, data description table and metadata, under a Dryad DOI and mirrored on Zenodo. Licence: CC0; free. Caveats: one building and two floors; gaps were filled during cleaning. Simulation uses: energy benchmarking, load-shape analysis, energy and occupancy prediction, fault detection and testing advanced HVAC controls. Related records: the AAU and NEST building dataset, the GECAD datasets and the Brick schema.
